origin: Codex assistant authored offline contextual situation contrasts
limitations: Assistant review only; professor and independent human adjudication pending.
Reserved example.invalid identifiers are fictional artifacts asserted as real within synthetic scenarios.
Public controls are directly authored contextual facts; no public dataset annotation is converted to truth.
Independently authored situations remain assistant provisional; assistant critic review is not human adjudication.
Clean targets operationalize absence of personal disclosure as S0 with empty categories; topic-only category targets are outside this controlled curriculum.
Guard and replay anchors are inherited unchanged from v1; the primary contrast changes only training situations.
